title: Inorganic Reaction Mechanisms Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Inorganic Reaction Mechanisms" will take place from 28 February to 5 March 2027 at Staybridge Suites Oxnard - River Ridge in Oxnard, United States. Applications must be submitted by 31 January 2027 through the conference page on grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
card_alt: Card for "Inorganic Reaction Mechanisms Conference" by Gordon Research Conferences in Oxnard, United States; application deadline 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York City, not Oxnard.
